card.headline: al riyadi lift the *dubai* title.
status: Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum Hall, Dubai

highlight.text: The winning margin in an all-Lebanese final.

caption:
Al Riyadi are champions of the Shabab Al Ahli International Basketball Championship in Dubai. 🏆

They beat Antonine 95-76 in an all-Lebanese final on Wednesday night at the Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum Hall.

Two Lebanese clubs in a final abroad, three days before the new Division A season tips off on Saturday. Congratulations to both. Who impressed you most in Dubai? 🇱🇧

Source: WAM, Grand Lebanon

facts.claim: Al Riyadi beat Antonine (Antonine Baabda) 95-76 in the final of the Shabab Al Ahli International Basketball Championship on Wednesday 21 October 2026 at the Sheikh Saeed bin Maktoum Hall (Al Mamzar, Dubai); Al Riyadi are champions; margin 19 points

facts.claim: Al Riyadi are from Beirut; Antonine are from Baabda (Antonine Baabda)
